## Original project repositories
- CyberDailyLog (flagship): CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, stateful CVE tracking and transitions, structured feeds and advisory text, correlation, prioritisation, reproducible reports, source health, explicit degradation and publication SLO monitoring. A learning project, not a SIEM or enterprise SOC service. https://github.com/JimBLogic/CyberDailyLog

- Defensive Homelab: deployment-ready reproducible baseline, operational validation in progress. LITE/FULL configurations and procedures do not prove live operation. Next evidence (all pending): baseline service health, authentication triage, Windows/Sysmon or equivalent telemetry, SIEM query, incident note, detection tuning. https://github.com/JimBLogic/defensive-homelab-blue-team
- Austrian Business Cycle Monitor: educational macro-data project; no investment advice or guaranteed data availability. https://github.com/JimBLogic/AustrianBusinessCycleMonitor
